_comment: Spell/ability definitions for Omega Realm — the slottable abilities (action-bar slots 1-4) acquired from Glory unlocks, items, or the skill tree, distinct from the per-class RMB Class ability (see data/spells/class_abilities.json). Holds each spell's effect shape and parameters {damage, speed, radius, lifetime, pierce, mana_cost, cooldown}. The Rust omega-server is the numeric authority: all spell damage and spawned world effects are server-authoritative and resolved in the authoritative tick, replicated via the ABILITY_EFFECT event ('the client requests, the server decides'); this file mirrors definitions for client VFX/tooling and the server wins on disagreement. Data-driven caveat: a parameterised spell is live-addable, but a genuinely new behaviour (teleport/reflect) needs a rust/sim_core change + deploy. Governing GDD doc: docs/systems/abilities.md, data/schemas/spell_schema.json, docs/gdd/loot.md (items that grant spells). TODO: every spell is unfilled pending design; the single example below is schema-shape only.

spells._comment: Keyed by stable spell id. One schema-shaped example entry. 'shape' is one of: instant_aoe | spawned_world_effect | projectile_spread | movement (mirrors the RMB ability effect shapes in abilities.md).
